## What this deck is doing

| **The problem it starts from** | The pool is shared and mispriced |
|---|---|
| **What it answers** | Premium, experience rating, repricing, the captive |
| **Vocabulary it introduces** | the draw · the acceptor · the premium |
| **Who it is for** | design partners and builders — and anybody who has reached the pool and the price on their own |
| **Roughly** | 25 minutes |
| **Where it deliberately stops** | nothing. This is the deep one and it should stay as deep as it is — it should be reached, not simplified |

It ends on the question it does not answer — **“What would have to be true to run one policy, on one agent, for one week?”**.
